evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Instituting a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/stability (conservation) and capability-readiness (competence) as the goods being mandated.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Equating unrehearsed with non-existent frames readiness as the measure of genuine capability (competence) and security (conservation).
The cadence label restates a recurring-stability arrangement as the operative value.
Naming an owner signals accountability for capability — the person responsible for ensuring the craft is maintained.
